data.name: Death's Shot
data.description: Three times per day, as an immediate action when the gunmaster scores a critical hit, he can attempt to kill his enemy instantly. When the gunmaster uses this talent, the target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw with a DC %1. On a failed saving throw, the target dies instantly.|10+VigilanteLVL/2+DEX
